{{Short description|Pakistani applied mathematician}}
{{Use dmy dates|cs1-dates=ly|date=August 2021}}
{{Use list-defined references|date=August 2021}}
'''Noreen Sher Akbar''' is a Pakistani [[applied mathematics|applied mathematician]] specializing in [[fluid dynamics]].{{r|isesco}} After obtaining her Ph.D. from [[Quaid-i-Azam University]],{{r|bys}} in 2012,  she joined the faculty at [[National University of Sciences and Technology (Pakistan)|National University of Sciences & Technology]],{{r|intech}} where she is head of the Department of Basic Sciences and Humanities.{{r|bsh}}

Akbar has won multiple honours for her research productivity including being listed as a Young Associate of the [[Pakistan Academy of Sciences]].{{r|isesco}} She was the 2012 winner of the Best Young Scientist award of the National Academy of Young Scientists,{{r|bys}} and the 2017 winner of the M. Raziuddin Siddiqi Prize and Gold Medal of the Pakistan Academy of Sciences.{{r|siddiqi}}
